note: Declared stats. min/max clamp every change, start is the value in a new game, int rounds to whole numbers. A name like "loyalty.*" applies to every variable that starts with "loyalty." (per person stats). Ranges are engine defaults and can be tuned in later sessions. Story text never prints these as numbers: use voice() and band() with content/voice.json. secrecy is how well hidden the hero is (higher is safer); cunning_brutal runs from -100 (cunning) to 100 (brutal). wealth is coin in each era's money (see content/rules.json scale). injury rises in lost fight exchanges and heals with $ do heal() or a long sleep. loyalty.keepers is the Valerius keeper family's loyalty as a whole (stewards in the long sleep).
